ms.promise: The UI designs for Eternl v2 will be mostly finished. (‘Mostly’ because app development is an iterative process).
ms.criteria:
We’ll be finished with the designs and layout for all parts of the new wallet v2. This includes layout for
The wallet creation process
The wallet overview for displaying funds and transactions made with the wallet
The sending page for sending ada, fungible and non fungible token
The receive page, where user can view their different receiving addresses
A settings page to configure various the features of the wallet
All views should have a light and a dark mode.
ms.report:
The screenshots show the mostly done designs for desktop and mobile. A teaser of dapp browser and nft details are includes. At this point we don't want to share those designs with the broader public (no announcements).

https://www.dropbox.com/sh/sxzdutiyrg15faj/AACI_3012hret9cEtSfJ1_vQa?dl=0
